svg.title: Tidewharf Landing — Twin ferry berths
svg.desc: A customs hut, two ferries and their mast gantries create a welcoming dock maze. Cargo stacks connect the boardwalk to the sail loft; danger berths are clearly separated. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

stacks connect the boardwalk to the sail loft; danger berths are clearly separated.
